rows.commentary: 0.4: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers a length ball on off, and Shafali Verma swings hard, carving it through square-leg into the gap with deep square-leg stationed back for a single.
0.5: Nomvelo Sibanda angles a short of length delivery outside off, allowing Anushka Sharma to drop onto the back foot and punch firmly to sweeper cover to get off the mark with a run.
0.6: Nomvelo Sibanda finds a good length with a hint of nip-back into off, prompting Shafali Verma onto the back foot to punch it straight to the fielder at mid-off.

1.1: Tendai Makusha sends down a full delivery that shapes into the stumps, pushed back by Anushka Sharma before the bowler deflects it onto the non-striker's stumps where Shafali Verma safely remains.
1.2: Tendai Makusha pitches on a good length just outside off, and Anushka Sharma moves to the back foot to punch the ball toward sweeper cover for a single.
1.3: Tendai Makusha maintains a tight good length on off, and Shafali Verma steps back to punch the ball directly to mid-off.
1.4: Tendai Makusha drifts down leg with a length ball that sits up, and Shafali Verma rocks back to pull it all the way over the deep backward square-leg fence for a maximum.
1.5: Tendai Makusha drops it on a good length outside off, and Shafali Verma drifts onto the back foot to punch it past the cover fielder for a single.
1.6: Tendai Makusha strays drastically away from the stumps, offering a wide delivery on a good length that Anushka Sharma watches sail past.
1.6: Tendai Makusha bowls full on off, drawing Anushka Sharma forward for a drive that takes a thick outside edge and races down to third man for a single.
2.1: Kudzai Chigora begins the over by erring significantly wide outside off, forcing the umpire to signal a wide.
2.1: Kudzai Chigora digs it in short of a length and rising outside off, leaving Anushka Sharma to flash her bat wildly at thin air.
2.2: Kudzai Chigora strays miles wide of off-stump, leaving Anushka Sharma waving in vain as another extra is added to the tally.
2.2: Kudzai Chigora forces a desperate outside edge from Anushka Sharma that flashes past Mupachikwa's outstretched right hand and races away to the fence.
2.3: Kudzai Chigora fires it wide outside off again, and Anushka Sharma watches it sail past for yet another extra.
2.3: Kudzai Chigora delivers a short ball outside off that Anushka Sharma cuts fiercely through the off-side gap, beating the sweeper cover fielder to the boundary.
2.4: Kudzai Chigora goes short outside off, and Anushka Sharma pushes off the back foot straight to the cover fielder without proper timing.
2.5: Kudzai Chigora overcorrects once more, slinging a massive wide way outside off that Anushka Sharma calmly ignores for the fourth extra of the over.
2.5: Dot ball from Kudzai Chigora to Anushka Sharma.
